results.title: Hidden Twilight Sparkle
results.description: You’re secretly the wise, curious leader who values growth and friendship. You have a deep mind, love learning, and care deeply about harmony. You’re an INFJ — thoughtful, insightful, and full of quiet magic.

results.title: Hidden Pinkie Pie
results.description: Beneath the surface, you’re a joyful, playful spirit who lives to make others happy. You hide a big heart and endless energy. You’re an ESFP — warm, lively, and full of light.

results.title: Hidden Rainbow Dash
results.description: You’re secretly bold, loyal, and ready for adventure. You hide a fierce love for your friends and a brave spirit. You’re an ESTP — confident, spontaneous, and true.

results.title: Hidden Rarity
results.description: Deep down, you’re creative, generous, and full of beauty. You hide a soft heart and a love for making things special. You’re an ENFJ — charming, kind, and inspiring.

results.title: Hidden Fluttershy
results.description: You’re secretly gentle, kind, and incredibly brave. You hide a huge heart and a quiet strength. You’re an ISFP — calm, creative, and full of compassion.

results.title: Hidden Applejack
results.description: Beneath the surface, you’re honest, hardworking, and deeply loyal. You hide a steady, reliable soul. You’re an ISTJ — practical, kind, and true to your word.

results.title: Hidden Starlight Glimmer
results.description: You’re secretly thoughtful, logical, and always growing. You hide a wise mind and a caring heart. You’re an INTP — curious, calm, and full of potential.

results.title: Hidden Spike
results.description: Deep down, you’re loyal, helpful, and full of heart. You hide a quiet devotion to those you love. You’re an ISFJ — gentle, dependable, and kind.

results.title: Hidden Princess Celestia
results.description: You’re secretly wise, kind, and full of grace. You hide a calm, guiding spirit. You’re an ENFJ — compassionate, visionary, and full of light.

results.title: Hidden Princess Luna
results.description: Beneath the surface, you’re deep, creative, and connected to quiet magic. You hide a gentle soul and a big heart. You’re an INFP — imaginative, kind, and full of wonder.

results.title: Hidden Shining Armor
results.description: You’re secretly brave, protective, and loyal to family. You hide a strong, steady heart. You’re an ESTJ — responsible, reliable, and kind.

results.title: Hidden Cadance
results.description: Deep down, you’re loving, warm, and full of joy. You hide a bright spirit that spreads love. You’re an ESFJ — kind, social, and full of heart.

results.title: Hidden Discord
results.description: You’re secretly clever, creative, and full of surprises. You hide a fun, unique spirit and a soft heart. You’re an ENTP — witty, imaginative, and one of a kind.

results.title: Hidden Trixie
results.description: Beneath the surface, you’re confident, expressive, and full of spirit. You hide a big heart and a love to shine. You’re an ENFP — creative, bold, and full of life.

results.title: Hidden Zecora
results.description: You’re secretly wise, calm, and full of quiet guidance. You hide a deep, thoughtful soul. You’re an INTJ — insightful, independent, and gentle.

results.title: Hidden Big Macintosh
results.description: Deep down, you’re strong, steady, and kind without words. You hide a quiet, reliable heart. You’re an ISTP — calm, practical, and silently strong.
